main.description: Hide a post in a community. Only the community's creator may call it, with service auth (lxm = this NSID). The post stays in its author's repo; this AppView stops showing it in the community's views and shows a placeholder in threads. Idempotent.

errors.name: NotCommunityCreator
errors.description: The caller did not create this community.

errors.name: NotInCommunity
errors.description: The post is not shown in this community.
